subject: MAP checkpoint — data handling & deployment decision triage
messages:
From: Lena Gomez <lena.gomez@brightgrid.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hayes <t.hayes@brightgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — BrightGrid POC (data + deployment questions)

Hi Grace / Jordan,

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. Per our security review, we need to lock down a few items before we sign the MAP and start the eval:

- Deployment mode: BrightGrid must evaluate both a VPC-hosted private deployment and an on-prem air-gapped option. Our legal & security teams will choose after the evaluation.
- Data retention: logs and inference traces for the POC must be retained for at least 90 days. Any PII must be purged from logs after 30 days unless explicitly needed for debugging.
- PII scope: customer-supplied datasets may include names and email addresses — we need a clear processing flow and redaction options.

Attached is our high-level control checklist and a sample network diagram for the infra team to review. Can you confirm which Redwood owners will drive network connectivity and the MAP action items? We'd like a short weekly checkpoint cadence (30 minutes) for the next four weeks.

Attachments: [BrightGrid_security_checklist.pdf]

Thanks,
Lena
Security & Compliance Lead, BrightGrid

Attachments: [MAP_tracker_v2.xlsx] (also shared: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAPtracker)

If that time doesn't work, let me know and Jordan can reschedule.

—Grace

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Gomez <lena.gomez@brightgrid.com>, Tom Hayes <t.hayes@brightgrid.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:51:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP checkpoint — data handling & deployment decision triage

Thanks — a few technical clarifications ahead of tomorrow's checkpoint:

- VPC/private: We can offer a customer VPC peering pattern and a private control plane. Requirements: static IPs for whitelisting, TLS mutual auth, and a firewall allowlist (we'll provide a sample TF config).
- On-prem: our on-prem package supports air-gapped installs but requires these minimums: 4x GPU nodes (NVIDIA A10 or equivalent), a bastion VM for initial install, and access to an internal S3-compatible objectstore (or we can host a temporary replication).
- KMS/HSM: For PII keys we support cloud KMS and external HSM via PKCS#11. If BrightGrid needs a dedicated HSM we need HSM certs and a POC key rotation plan.
- Retention: By default our runtime creates short-lived inference traces (48 hours). We can extend retention to 90d but that increases storage and cost; propose a configurable retention flag per-environment.

Action items for the first checkpoint:
- I'll attach a sample VPC peering checklist and an example TF allowlist snippet (will share after this mail).
- Marissa: please draft a lightweight on-prem install readiness doc for 3/26.

Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Gomez <lena.gomez@brightgrid.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP checkpoint — data handling & deployment decision triage

Adding operational rollout detail here — rough eval plan proposal:

Week 0 (prep):
- Validate credentials + network allowlist (owner: BrightGrid infra)
- Redwood provides a sandbox model build & initial quantized image (owner: Marissa)

Week 1 (connectivity + small-scale perf):
- VPC peering test or on-prem connectivity test (owner: Karthik)
- Run a 2-hour perf run with representative prompts; capture latency and token cost (owner: Marissa)

Week 2 (PII & retention verification):
- Run evals with redaction on/off to verify PII masking and log purge behavior (owner: Grace + Karthik)
- Verify retention lifecycle for traces at 30d/90d and automated purge scripts (owner: Karthik)

Week 3 (canary + sign-off):
- Canary traffic to selected routes (owner: Jordan)
- Final security checklist sign-off and contract amendment (owner: Lena/Tom)

Estimated close timeline: if tests pass on schedule, target to move to contract signature 4/12 and production go-live early May.

I'll prepare a one-pager install checklist and a small test harness by Friday.

—Marissa
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: BrightGrid Security Team <security@brightgrid.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Gomez <lena.gomez@brightgrid.com>, Tom Hayes <t.hayes@brightgrid.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — data handling & deployment decision triage

Grace / Karthik — a couple clarifications from our infra/security team: 

- Redaction: we need proof that redaction happens client-side where possible (before logs leave BrightGrid). If Redwood relies on server-side redaction, we require a fallback that never persists raw PII in long-term traces.
- Retention windows: confirm whether the 30-day purge is irreversible and if there's a 7-day recovery buffer. We prefer irreversible purging after 30 days but want a 7-day staging period for debugging with explicit approvals.
- Audit logs: we need an exportable audit trail of who accessed traces and when (CSV or syslog).

We've uploaded our internal network diagram and a quick SOC2 scope reference here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=BrightGridSecurityAssets.

—BG Security
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lena Gomez <lena.gomez@brightgrid.com>, BrightGrid Security Team <security@brightgrid.com>

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP checkpoint notes + owners (summary and next steps)

Thanks all — summary from today's check and agreed next actions. Please treat this as the canonical MAP action list and update the shared tracker if anything is missing.

Meeting notes (3/29):
- Confirmed cadence: weekly 30-min checkpoints (Tuesdays 10:00 PT).
- Deployment modes: BrightGrid will evaluate VPC-private first (lower integration friction), with an optional on-prem dry-run if networking/latency requirements mandate.
- PII handling: Redwood will provide a client-side redaction SDK for customer data ingest. Server-side tracing will default to 48h; optional extended retention to 90d available behind a config flag and cost addendum.

Action items (owner — due):
- Karthik: Share VPC peering TF snippet and sample firewall allowlist (due 2027-03-31).
- Marissa: Draft on-prem install readiness doc + minimal hardware checklist (due 2027-04-02).
- Grace: Draft MAP amendment language for retention options & PII handling for legal review (due 2027-04-05).
- Jordan: Prepare canary routing plan and test harness outline (due 2027-04-09).
- BrightGrid (Lena/Tom): Confirm whether they require an irreversible 30d purge or a 7-day recovery staging (response due 2027-03-31).

Attachments (shared): [MAP_tracker_v2.xlsx], [VPC_network_diagram.png], [SOC2_scope_summary.pdf] 
Shared links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAPtracker | HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9821

If there are no objections I'll circulate a one-line MAP amendment for signature by 4/07 to lock the retention terms.

Best,
—Grace O'Connor
